# The Ronin's Redemption

A ronin, cast out and wandering, becomes a hero when he rescues the Shogun's daughter from robbers and is rewarded with a generalship.

## Characters
- "the woman in grey": a young East Asian woman with fair skin, long black hair pinned up with three jade hairpins, wearing a pale grey silk kimono with a silver obi.
- "the ronin": a lean man in his late thirties with a topknot and a scarred brow, wearing a faded indigo haori and dark hakama.
- "robber leader": a burly man in his forties with a thick beard, wearing a torn brown haori and leather pants, carrying a short sword.
- "horse": a dark bay horse with a white blaze on its face, wearing a saddle and bridle.
- "shogun": an older East Asian man with grey hair, wearing a dark red silk robe with a golden sash, standing in a courtyard.

Narration: He had once been a loyal samurai, but now he walks alone, a ghost among the living.
